responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend AST desugaring pass for argument-position `impl Trait` in function signatures. It recursively rewrites `AST::ImplTraitType` occurrences inside parameter type syntax into synthetic named type parameters, generates unique placeholder identifiers and replacement `TypePath` nodes, and then updates the surrounding `Function` item by appending the synthesized `GenericParam` entries and any required `WhereClause` constraints, including handling nested occurrences inside tuples, arrays, references, slices, parenthesized types, and generic bindings on trait bounds.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation of the `DesugarApit` pass declared in `rust-desugar-apit.h`: it performs the actual AST rewrite of argument-position `impl Trait`, including recursive type traversal, synthesis of placeholder type parameters, and insertion of generated generic parameters and where-clause items into `AST::Function` nodes.
